bio.text: Jose Javier Rodriguez is the Democratic candidate for Florida Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rodriguez served in the Florida House of Representatives (District 112) from 2012 to 2016 and in the Florida State Senate (District 37) from 2016 to 2020.
Rodriguez earned a B.A. from Brown University in 2000 and a J.D. from Harvard Law School in 2006, and has worked as an attorney.
